{{Quote|Leia's strike force set out for the stronghold, aiming to recapture the Vor'Na'Tu artifact at any cost. Rumors of Darth Vader spread among the crews, that Vader had been dispatched by the Emperor to retrieve the valuable item. I never put much stock in rumors, but you can never dismiss them completely.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The '''Battle of Geddes''' was a battle of the [[Krantian Civil War]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] managed to recover the [[Vor'Na'Tu]], an ancient and powerful [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]] on Krant, and shipped it to [[Hanoon|Geddes]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Krant and site of an Imperial research base, where it was stored in a [[Sith temple (Geddes)|Sith Temple]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] went to pick it up.<ref name="SW:GB" />

Later, the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Utric Sandov]] arranged a meeting on Krant with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to discuss information that could be vital to the Rebel Alliance. After her [[Skirmish in the Krant system|crash]] on the planet, Organa met the exiled [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], who had been hiding there since the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. They eventually [[Battle of Krant (Galactic Civil War)|found]] Utric Sandov who revealed to them the discovery the Vor'Na'Tu. Shen-Jon and Organa resolved to go to Geddes in order to obtain the artifact.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|I guess your purge wasn't efficient enough, Vader!|Echuu Shen-Jon to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
Organa and Shen-Jon arrived on-board a [[Unidentified GR-75 medium transport (Krant)|transport]] with a small [[Army/Legends|army]]&mdash;9 [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]], 3 [[T1-B hovertank]]s, and three [[Energy pummel/Legends|pummels]]. Organa also brought her translater, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], along. During the voyage, rumors spread that Darth Vader was on his way. Shortly after their arrival on the asteroid, [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] came to the aid of Organa and Shen-Jon. The timely arrival of Attichitcuk and his contingent of Wookiee warriors and war machines proved critical in the battle.<ref name="SW:GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
They split their forces, with one group creating a diversion while Shen-Jon and the pummels approached from behind the base. They discovered explosive droids which the research facility had built, and Shen-Jon used his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers to [[Mind trick/Legends|convert]] them for the Rebel's use. Their explosives further disrupted the base, allowing the pummels to break through and destroy the Sith Temple.<ref name="SW:GB" />
{{Endgame}}

[[File:Echuu_Vader.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Echuu Shen-Jon]] confronts [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].]]

Shen-Jon grabbed the Vor'Na'Tu, and the survivors retreated back to the landing zone. But upon returning to their transport they found Darth Vader, who was awaiting their arrival. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] demanded that they hand over the relic to him in order to bring back to his master, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Shen-Jon, fearing the results of the Vor'Na'Tu falling into the Emperor's hands, refused to surrender and shattered the item into four pieces, rendering it useless to Vader. Engaging Vader in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Shen-Jon's skills were no match for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] and eventually Echuu Shen-Jon was killed. But in dueling Vader, he gave Princess Organa enough time to escape.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|When I was a child, I was told the Jedi were a myth, just a story. Echuu Shen-Jon was no myth, these valiant Jedi seemed destined to sacrifice their lives in pursuit of their ideals. But his death was not in vain. The Vor'Na'Tu was now shattered and useless to the Emperor, or so we all thought.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
Soon after the battle, Organa became involved in an Imperial plot involving [[Finn Darktrin]] and [[Dusque Mistflier]].<ref name="NEC" /> The Alliance felt that the threat of the artifact had been rendered useless. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] after his [[Death/Legends|death]], though, Echuu Shen-Jon contacted Princess Leia through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and warned her about the potential power of the shards of the Vor'Na'Tu. A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force led by Leia Organa Solo and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Battle of Hanoon|returned]] to the asteroid to retrieve the shards.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Geddes was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] to the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. It appeared during a Princess Leia campaign mission. The game's strategy guide recommends the player split the forces and just concentrate on grabbing the Vor'Na'Tu. Converting the explosive droids is an optional objective. This article assumes 100% completion of objectives and follows the guide's recommended strategy. The mission and thus the battle was also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. The [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' both included dates for the battle.
